body.zh-Hant: 崔可夫（1900–1982）生於圖拉省，1918年加入紅軍，1919年入共產黨。內戰期間他任團長；1925年自伏龍芝軍事學院畢業，1936年再自紅軍機械化摩托化學院畢業。
body.en: Vasily Chuikov (1900–1982) was born in Tula province, joined the Red Army in 1918 and the Communist Party in 1919. He commanded a regiment in the civil war, graduated from the Frunze Academy in 1925 and from the Red Army Academy of Motorization and Mechanization in 1936.

heading.en: Far East staff, 9th Army and China posting

body.zh-Hant: 1929至1932年他任蘇聯遠東軍參謀部部長。他在一場惡名昭彰的敗仗之後被擢升指揮第9集團軍，該敗仗發生於蘇芬戰爭（1939–1940）；1940至1942年他出任駐中國軍事武官。
body.en: From 1929 to 1932 he headed the staff department of the Soviet Far East forces. He was elevated to command the 9th Army after its notorious defeat in the Soviet–Finnish War (1939–1940), and from 1940 to 1942 he served as military attaché in China.

heading.zh-Hant: 史達林格勒防衛與柏林戰役
heading.en: Defence of Stalingrad and the Berlin operation

body.zh-Hant: 崔可夫在通往史達林格勒的激戰中指揮第64集團軍，其後以第62集團軍頑強死守這座殘破的城市，因而成名。1943年起他指揮近衛第8集團軍直到戰爭結束，1945年4月率部攻向柏林。
body.en: Chuikov commanded the 64th Army in the bitter fighting en route to Stalingrad and then the 62nd Army in its tenacious defence of the ruined city, which made his name. He commanded the Eighth Guards Army from 1943 to the end of the war and spearheaded the final drive on Berlin in April 1945.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰後指揮職與晉升元帥
heading.en: Post-war commands and marshal rank

body.zh-Hant: 戰後他歷任駐德蘇軍總司令（1949–1953）、基輔軍區司令（1953–1960），1960至1964年任國防次官，並於1960至1961年兼任地面部隊總司令。他於1955年晉升元帥，1961年起為黨中央委員。
body.en: After the war he served as commander-in-chief of Soviet forces in Germany (1949–1953), commander of the Kiev Military District (1953–1960) and deputy defence minister (1960–1964), also heading the ground forces in 1960–1961. He became a marshal in 1955 and a Central Committee member from 1961.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇芬戰爭、史達林格勒保衛戰與柏林戰役中的指揮
heading.en: Command in the Winter War, the defence of Stalingrad and the Berlin offensive

body.zh-Hant: 蘇芬戰爭期間，第9集團軍自1939年12月中旬起由崔可夫（時為軍長級）指揮。1942年9月10日起他任第62集團軍司令，在史達林格勒保衛戰中據守該市。1943年4月至1945年5月他任近衛第8集團軍司令，該軍參加伊久姆—巴爾文科沃與頓巴斯作戰及第聶伯河戰役；1944年8月該軍在波蘭馬格努舍夫橋頭堡突破德軍防線並強渡維斯瓦河，1945年1至2月強攻要塞城市波茲南，其後進抵奧得河、奪取屈斯特林附近橋頭堡，打開通往柏林的道路。
body.en: During the Winter War the 9th Army was led from mid-December 1939 by Chuikov, then a corps commander. From 10 September 1942 he commanded the 62nd Army in the defence of Stalingrad. From April 1943 to May 1945 he commanded the 8th Guards Army, which took part in the Izyum–Barvenkovo and Donbas operations and the battle for the Dnieper; in August 1944 it broke through at the Magnuszew bridgehead in Poland and crossed the Vistula, in January–February 1945 it stormed the fortress city of Poznań, and it then reached the Oder and seized a bridgehead near Küstrin, opening the direct road to Berlin.

body.en: Boris Shaposhnikov (1882–1945) began as a career officer in tsarist service and graduated from the Nicholas Academy of the General Staff in 1910, then served in Turkestan and the Warsaw Military District. He reached regimental command in the First World War, joined the Red Army in 1918 and held high staff posts in the civil war.

body.zh-Hant: 1925至1928年他指揮列寧格勒與莫斯科軍區，1928至1931年任工農紅軍參謀長，其後出任伏爾加軍區司令。1933至1935年他主持伏龍芝軍事學院，之後轉任列寧格勒軍區司令。
body.en: From 1925 to 1928 he commanded the Leningrad and Moscow military districts, and from 1928 to 1931 he was chief of staff of the Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, followed by command of the Volga Military District. From 1933 to 1935 he headed the Frunze Military Academy, after which he commanded the Leningrad Military District.

heading.zh-Hant: 總參謀長與軍事理論
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and military theory

body.zh-Hant: 1937至1940年他任新設紅軍總參謀部的第二把手；冬季戰爭（1939–1940）後出任國防副人民委員。1941年7月底他接替朱可夫，任總參謀長至1942年5月；1943至1945年任總參謀學院院長。他的《軍隊的大腦》三卷（1927–1929）研究奧地利康拉德的模式，主張建立現代蘇聯總參謀部。
body.en: From 1937 to 1940 he served as second chief of the newly created Red Army General Staff and, after the Winter War (1939–1940), as deputy defence commissar. At the end of July 1941 he replaced Georgy Zhukov as chief of the General Staff until May 1942, and in 1943–1945 he headed the Academy of the General Staff. His three-volume Brain of the Army (1927–1929) studied the Austrian model of Conrad von Hoetzendorf and argued for a modern Soviet general staff.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇芬戰爭之後與1941至1942年戰役期間的總參謀長任職
heading.en: After the Winter War and the 1941–42 campaign: Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 沙波什尼科夫在蘇芬戰爭（1939–1940）這場戰役之後被任命為國防副人民委員。1941年7月10日大本營改組為最高統帥部大本營時，他是最初的成員之一；7月下旬他接替朱可夫出任總參謀長，任期至1942年5月（《大蘇維埃百科全書》記為1941年7月至1942年5月），涵蓋蘇德戰爭初期的各次作戰。其後他回任國防副人民委員，1943至1945年出任總參謀學院院長。
body.en: After the Winter War (1939–1940) Shaposhnikov was appointed deputy Defence Commissar. When the Stavka was reorganised on 10 July 1941 as the Stavka of the Supreme Command he was among its first members; at the end of July he replaced Zhukov as Chief of the General Staff, serving until May 1942 (the Great Soviet Encyclopedia gives July 1941 – May 1942). He then reverted to deputy Defence Commissar and from 1943 to 1945 served as chief of the Academy of the General Staff.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與內戰
heading.en: Origins and civil war

body.zh-Hant: 鐵木辛哥（1895–1970）生於烏克蘭，第一次世界大戰中以士兵身分參戰，十月革命後加入紅軍。內戰期間他作為指揮官主要在南部與史達林等人共事，1919年入共產黨。
body.en: Semyon Timoshenko (1895–1970) was born in Ukraine, served as a soldier in the First World War and joined the Red Army after the October Revolution. In the civil war he commanded troops chiefly in the south alongside Stalin and others, and joined the Communist Party in 1919.

heading.zh-Hant: 衛國戰爭與戰後
heading.en: The Great Patriotic War and after

body.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰初期，他以西部方面軍總司令身分在斯摩棱斯克擊敗德軍，其後指揮西南方面軍與史達林格勒方面軍等。1942年夏德軍向史達林格勒推進時，新組建的史達林格勒方面軍最初由蘇聯元帥鐵木辛哥指揮，防禦階段自7月17日展開。戰後他歷任白俄羅斯軍區司令等職，葬於克里姆林宮牆。
body.en: In the early Second World War he commanded the Western Front and defeated German forces at Smolensk, and later directed the South-Western Front and the Stalingrad Front, among others. When the Germans advanced on Stalingrad in the summer of 1942, the newly formed Stalingrad Front was at first commanded by Marshal Timoshenko, and the defensive phase of the battle began on 17 July. After the war he commanded the Belorussian Military District, among other posts, and was buried in the Kremlin Wall.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇芬戰爭、斯摩棱斯克、哈爾科夫與史達林格勒方向的作戰
heading.en: Operations from the Winter War to Smolensk, Kharkov and Stalingrad

body.zh-Hant: 1940年1月7日，蘇軍在卡累利阿地峽成立西北方面軍，由鐵木辛哥任司令，任務是突破曼納海姆防線；2月11日該方面軍轉入進攻。1941年蘇德戰爭初期，他任西方面軍司令，迎擊德軍對斯摩棱斯克的攻勢；《哥倫比亞百科全書》另載，他接替布瓊尼後於1941年11月主導收復頓河畔羅斯托夫。1942年5月12日，由他指揮的西南方面軍在哈爾科夫方向發動進攻，結局是蘇軍遭到嚴重失敗；7月12日新成立的史達林格勒方面軍由他任司令，7月23日由戈爾多夫接任。1942年10月起他再任西北方面軍司令，至1943年3月。
body.en: On 7 January 1940 the North-Western Front was formed on the Karelian Isthmus under Timoshenko, with the task of breaking the Mannerheim Line; it went over to the offensive on 11 February. In the opening phase of the German–Soviet war he commanded the Western Front against the German offensive towards Smolensk; the Columbia Encyclopedia adds that after replacing Budenny he led the recapture of Rostov-on-Don in November 1941. On 12 May 1942 the South-Western Front under his command attacked in the Kharkov direction and the operation ended in a heavy Soviet defeat; on 12 July the newly formed Stalingrad Front came under his command, and on 23 July Gordov took over. From October 1942 to March 1943 he again commanded the North-Western Front.

people.name: Franz Conrad von Hötzendorf
people.nameZh: 法蘭茲·康拉德·馮·赫岑多夫

heading.zh-Hant: 軍旅養成
heading.en: Training and early career

body.zh-Hant: 康拉德畢業於維也納新城的特蕾西亞軍事學院，成為獵兵軍官後進入維也納戰爭學校。他以參謀軍官身分參加1878至1879年佔領波士尼亞—赫塞哥維納及1882年的戰鬥，1888至1892年任戰爭學校教官，1895年起指揮第1步兵團。他在1899至1903年以少將統率的里雅斯特的第55旅，1903年起以中將指揮因斯布魯克的第8步兵師。
body.en: Conrad graduated from the Theresian Military Academy in Wiener Neustadt, became a Jäger officer and entered the Vienna War School. As a General Staff officer he took part in the occupation of Bosnia-Herzegovina in 1878–79 and the fighting there in 1882, taught at the War School in 1888–92 and took command of the 1st Infantry Regiment in 1895. As major general he led the 55th Brigade in Trieste in 1899–1903, and from 1903 he commanded the 8th Infantry Division in Innsbruck as Feldmarschalleutnant.

heading.zh-Hant: 總參謀長與阿倫塔爾之爭
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff and the clash with Aehrenthal

body.zh-Hant: 1906年11月18日，康拉德受弗朗茨·斐迪南大公賞識，被任命為全軍總參謀長。他主張以預防性戰爭對付義大利與塞爾維亞，與外交大臣阿倫塔爾嚴重衝突，1911年12月3日被改任軍團督察。1912年12月12日他在貝希托爾德任內重返原職。
body.en: On 18 November 1906 Conrad, favoured by Archduke Franz Ferdinand, became chief of the General Staff of the entire armed forces. He advocated preventive war against Italy and Serbia, clashed with Foreign Minister Aehrenthal, and on 3 December 1911 was moved to the post of army inspector. He was recalled on 12 December 1912 under Aehrenthal's successor Berchtold.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰：東線、巴爾幹與義大利戰線
heading.en: First World War: Eastern Front, Balkans and the Italian front

body.zh-Hant: 大戰中康拉德任總司令腓特烈大公的參謀長，卻握有指揮作戰的廣泛全權。1914年底他與興登堡在東線建起連續戰線；1915年他的戈爾利采突破計劃得到德軍協助；征服塞爾維亞後只取得蒙特內哥羅與北阿爾巴尼亞；他並主持對義大利伊松佐一線的防禦，並在對羅馬尼亞的戰役中有貢獻。
body.en: In the war Conrad was chief of staff to the army commander Archduke Friedrich but held wide authority over operations. By the end of 1914 he and Hindenburg had built a continuous front in the east; in 1915 his plan to break through at Gorlice was realised with German help; after the defeat of Serbia he had to settle for Montenegro and northern Albania; and he organised the defence against Italy on the Isonzo and contributed to the campaign against Romania.

heading.zh-Hant: 辭任總參謀長與集團軍群
heading.en: Resignation as chief of staff and army-group command

body.zh-Hant: 康拉德1915年晉升上將、1916年晉升元帥。1917年3月1日，因與年輕的卡爾一世皇帝的政治路線不合，他辭去總參謀長，轉任對義大利作戰的集團軍群司令，1917至1918年守住提洛與克恩頓一線。1918年7月15日，在六月攻勢失敗後，他被解除該職。
body.en: Conrad was promoted to colonel-general in 1915 and field marshal in 1916. On 1 March 1917, at odds with the political course of the much younger Emperor Karl I, he resigned as chief of staff and took command of an army group against Italy, holding the fronts in Tyrol and Carinthia in 1917–18. On 15 July 1918, after the failed June offensive, he was relieved of that command.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與軍校
heading.en: Origins and military training

body.zh-Hant: 凱末爾（1881–1938）生於奧斯曼帝國治下的薩洛尼卡。1905年他自陸軍大學畢業，以參謀大尉身分派往大馬士革的第5軍；1907年轉往薩洛尼卡的第3軍，並加入統一與進步委員會（青年土耳其黨）。
body.en: Mustafa Kemal (1881–1938) was born in Salonica under Ottoman rule. He graduated from the War College in 1905 and was posted as a staff captain to the Fifth Army in Damascus; in 1907 he moved to the Third Army in Salonica and joined the Committee of Union and Progress (the Young Turks).

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭中的指揮與加里波利
heading.en: Wartime commands and Gallipoli

body.zh-Hant: 1909年三三一事件時，他組成行動軍並以參謀長身分出動鎮壓。1911年他參加抗擊義大利入侵的黎波里的戰鬥，1915年任新編師師長，在恰納卡萊阻止英法聯軍登陸，成為民族英雄；其後在高加索戰線擊敗俄軍。1916年他任敘利亞方面軍司令，在阿勒坡以北構築防線，但戰事失利。
body.en: During the 31 March incident of 1909 he formed the Action Army and went out as its chief of staff. In 1911 he fought against the Italian invasion of Tripoli; in 1915 he took command of a newly raised division and halted the Anglo-French landing at Çanakkale, becoming a national hero, then defeated the Russians on the Caucasus front. In 1916 he commanded the Syrian front and built a line north of Aleppo, but the campaign was lost.

heading.zh-Hant: 祖國解放戰爭與共和國
heading.en: The War of Liberation and the Republic

body.zh-Hant: 1919年5月19日他前往薩姆松，展開祖國解放戰爭；1920年在安卡拉召開大國民議會，並在薩卡里亞戰役中擊退入侵安納托利亞的希臘軍，於穆達尼亞與協約國休戰。1923年他簽訂洛桑條約，宣布成立土耳其共和國並出任首任總統。他於1938年11月10日在伊斯坦堡的多爾瑪巴赫切宮病逝。
body.en: On 19 May 1919 he left for Samsun and began the war of national liberation; in 1920 he convened the Grand National Assembly in Ankara, defeated the Greek army advancing into Anatolia at the Battle of Sakarya and concluded an armistice with the Allies at Mudanya. In 1923 he concluded the Treaty of Lausanne, proclaimed the Republic of Turkey and became its first president. He died of illness at Dolmabahçe Palace in Istanbul on 10 November 1938.
